built_for: -09-72a point-in-time append-only observation envelope feasibility census

envelope_rules.cutoff_rule: historical captured producer rule: greatest configured cutoff no later than wall clock and no later than the envelope latest observation minute; wall cutoff if no cutoff is eligible
envelope_rules.fallback: when the point-in-time WU envelope has no cutoff-eligible row, retain that snapshot's captured served high_so_far; no non-WU input is changed

rules.envelope_last: for a restated timestamp retain the temperature in the most recent payload at or before the current snapshot
rules.envelope_max: for a restated timestamp retain the highest native-unit temperature observed at or before the current snapshot

envelope_rules.snapshot_order: captured_at_utc ascending within each replay_inputs.jsonl, with original file position as the stable tie-break; raw append-order inversions are counted
envelope_rules.timestamp_identity: target-date-local minute_of_day from each valid WU history (time,temp) row

explicitly_not_done: no alpha allocation or spend, candidate fit or freeze, Brier or CRPS computation, market comparison, C endpoint, or ledger decision
no high_so_far, cutoff_hour, producer, floor, collection, replay, scoring, settlement, model, or serving change
no provider or exchange call, production data write, registration, restart, promotion, activation, release, trade, merge, or PR

method.interval_treatment: exact finite-population input-integrity census; no outcome, interval, bootstrap, power calculation, or alpha look was performed

replay.point_in_time_rule: current snapshot plus only strictly earlier snapshots; max prior receipt asserted < current capture

support.snapshot_root: data/snapshots under the complete workstation evidence root

train_serve.definition: absolute distance to the eligible archive-rebuilt training high_so_far at each path's own cutoff
